entry.title: Japan's exports rise for third month as chip demand offsets US tariffs
entry.summary: Shipments of semiconductor equipment to China and Taiwan drove a 4.1% increase in August, while car exports to the US fell for a sixth straight month.

entry.title: Toyota to invest $10bn in US battery plants
entry.content: The carmaker will expand its North Carolina complex and build a second site in Kentucky as it bets on hybrids and plug-in models amid slowing demand for fully electric cars.
